name: Agent Workflow — Sharp Glassmorphism
description: Frosted-glass agent execution stepper floating over a living gradient mesh, visualizing Plan, Search, Reason, Act, Reflect, Respond. Translucent layered nodes glow cyan when done and fuchsia when running, with a gradient filling progress bar. A Run button drives steps through pending → running → done on a timer with a live log line. Respects prefers-reduced-motion.
features: cyan done + fuchsia running node glow
